subject.title: Feature: Add /models test-fallback command to verify fallback chain

question: Should OpenClaw add a targeted `/models test-fallback` command, fold this into broader `openclaw models status --probe --all` work, or defer it to staged model-migration UX?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent command contract overlaps existing auth probes plus open model diagnostics and migration-safety requests, so automation should not choose the product surface alone.

options.title: Add Targeted Fallback Probe
options.body: Add a focused slash and/or CLI command that starts at fallback candidates and supports first-fallback plus all-fallback modes.

options.title: Fold Into Status Probe
options.body: Make the broader configured-model health-check work own fallback-chain testing and add command discoverability there.

options.title: Defer To Migration UX
options.body: Treat fallback testing as one step in a staged model migration workflow instead of adding a standalone command now.

recommendation.title: Add Targeted Fallback Probe
recommendation.body: Add a focused slash and/or CLI command that starts at fallback candidates and supports first-fallback plus all-fallback modes.

likelyOwner.reason: He already gave the clearest product-scope guidance on this issue and has direct history on overlapping model-status/probe surfaces.
